notes: Founder-led account: Ava Moreno (founder + CTO). Very technical, bootstrapped but revenue-generating.
Primary target: embed a lightweight support assistant inside product and index docs with embeddings for fast semantic search.
Prefers self-serve onboarding; wants to avoid long procurement. Interested in reserved capacity only if cost delta is compelling.
Main decision driver: price per 1M tokens (generation) + price per 1k embedding units. Wants explicit numbers to compare to OpenAI and Anthropic.
Latency expectation: p95 <350ms for generation at 512 tokens for east-us region. Throughput low initially (10-50 rps), may grow to 200 rps in 6-12 months.
Cost sensitivity: high. Founder said on call: 'If we can get parity with OpenAI on price and better reliability, we switch.'
Security: SOC2 is required; SSO/SAML not necessary for now but audit logging and retention controls are desired.
Technical constraints: using React front-end with server-side proxy; tokens heavy on short responses (50-200 tokens) for chat; embeddings batch jobs nightly for new docs.
Requested artifacts: simple pricing table (per-token gen, context, embeddings), example monthly cost for 500k gen tokens + 100k embeddings, and guidance on rate limiting and burst behavior.
Suggested next step on call: provide cost model + enable 14-day hosted credits so they can A/B with OpenAI sample workload. Founder to run two 24h runs and report latency/cost.
Notes: leaning toward Redwood hosted API for ease of migration if pricing can be matched. Wants to test model routing fallback to cheaper variants during spikes.
Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize recommendations later (batching/quantization) if usage grows and cost savings needed.
Internal: assign SE (Liam) to prepare a concise one-pager and run a small benchmark on east-us with model x-small (open model) and report p95 latency numbers.
Email thread and deck links stored in Drive. Follow-up scheduled after trial results (target check-in 2026-03-18).
